mapper.sql: FROM pay_fee_detail t JOIN pay_fee pf ON pf.fee_id=t.fee_id AND pf.community_id=t.community_id AND pf.status_cd='0' WHERE t.community_id=#{communityId} AND t.status_cd='0' AND t.state='1400' AND t.fee_id=#{feeId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owner_app_user a JOIN building_owner bo ON bo.member_id=a.member_id AND bo.community_id=a.community_id AND bo.status_cd='0' WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.community_id=t.community_id AND a.status_cd='0' AND a.state='12000' AND ( (pf.payer_obj_type='3333' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM building_owner_room_rel rr JOIN building_room r ON r.room_id=rr.room_id AND r.community_id=t.community_id AND r.status_cd='0' WHERE rr.owner_id=bo.owner_id AND rr.room_id=pf.payer_obj_id AND rr.status_cd='0' AND rr.state='2001' )) OR (pf.payer_obj_type IN ('6666','parking') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owner_car c WHERE c.owner_id=bo.member_id AND c.community_id=t.community_id AND c.status_cd='0' AND ((pf.payer_obj_type='6666' AND c.car_id=pf.payer_obj_id) OR (pf.payer_obj_type='parking' AND c.ps_id=pf.payer_obj_id)) )) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.detail_id detailId,t.fee_id feeId,t.received_amount receivedAmount,t.cycles, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') startTime,DATE_FORMAT(t.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') endTime, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime,t.remark, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(NULLIF(fa.value,'')) FROM pay_fee_attrs fa WHERE fa.fee_id=pf.fee_id AND fa.spec_cd='390002' AND fa.status_cd='0'), (SELECT MAX(fc.fee_name) FROM pay_fee_config fc WHERE fc.config_id=pf.config_id AND fc.community_id=pf.community_id AND fc.status_cd='0'), '费用') feeName, CASE WHEN pf.payer_obj_type='3333' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT CONCAT_WS('-',f.floor_num,u.unit_num,r.room_num) FROM building_room r LEFT JOIN building_unit u ON u.unit_id=r.unit_id AND u.status_cd='0' LEFT JOIN f_floor f ON f.floor_id=u.floor_id AND f.status_cd='0' WHERE r.room_id=pf.payer_obj_id AND r.community_id=pf.community_id AND r.status_cd='0' LIMIT 1),pf.payer_obj_id) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT MAX(c.car_num) FROM owner_car c WHERE c.community_id=pf.community_id AND c.status_cd='0' AND ((pf.payer_obj_type='6666' AND c.car_id=pf.payer_obj_id) OR (pf.payer_obj_type='parking' AND c.ps_id=pf.payer_obj_id))),pf.payer_obj_id) END payerObjName
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC,t.detail_id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{row}
